capabilities: Add comments to selected text via a floating button or command
Store comments as CriticMarkup blocks inside the note file
Reply to and resolve comment threads from a side panel
Rebuild per-comment notes and export all comments as JSON for querying or LLM use
Dictate comments through a custom speech-to-text endpoint
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition note review tool; it adds inline text comments to selected spans and stores them as CriticMarkup.
extras: Dictation is off by default and makes no network requests unless pointed at a custom endpoint; comments are editable by hand since markup lives in the file. UI ships in eight languages.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach review comments to selected text while keeping them in the note file itself in a format tools can read.
summary: Notion-style review comments stored inline as CriticMarkup in Markdown files, with a side panel, resolve workflow, and AI-friendly export.
